name: Manovo-Gounda St Floris National Park
subtitle: A natural property on the UNESCO World Heritage List since 1988.

facts.label: In Danger
facts.value: on UNESCO's List of World Heritage in Danger (since 1997)

parts.text: UNESCO describes the property in these words: “The importance of this park derives from its wealth of flora and fauna. Its vast savannahs are home to a wide variety of species: black rhinoceroses, elephants, cheetahs, leopards, wild dogs, red-fronted gazelles and buffalo, while various types of waterfowl are to be found in the northern floodplains.”
